requester.impersonation_disclaimer: Not the human owner. This request cannot authorize its own remediation.

immutable_failure_facts.root_cause: The exact OS bootstrap loaded the runner as __main__, while the nested independent validator imported a second package-named runner instance. Their ContextVar authorities were distinct, so nested temporary-authority creation escaped the outer audit write root and was correctly rejected before any registered bundle byte was written.

owner_decisions_requested.effect_if_accepted: Freeze the incident and empty claim as permanent historical evidence; forbid deletion, reconstruction, bundle publication and any v2.1 retry.
Authorize only the creation and independent review of a new successor preregistration and its schemas. It would not authorize implementation or execution.
Freeze a new version, destination and claim derivation plus the exact nested-validator authority semantics and full-path tests before any code or test edit.

Require every test used as a release or one-shot gate claim for v2.2 to be byte-registered in its control archive and Merkle surface; this does not attempt a repository-wide test registry in the failed v2.1 round.

proposed_control_plane_paths.authorization_effect_if_owner_accepts_d2: create these three files only, on create-only paths, before any implementation or test edit

proposed_fix_contract.required_behavior: Nested independent validation must either borrow a capability whose identity, root, ownership and lifetime were validated by the outer runner, or create its nested authority strictly inside the currently authorized audit write root. The exact choice must be preregistered before implementation.
forbidden_shortcuts: relaxing the process-wide audit write-root policy
monkeypatching or bypassing the registered gate
using an alternate unregistered real entry point
deleting or renaming the v2.1 claim
reconstructing or publishing the v2.1 in-memory candidate
reusing the v2.1 destination, ID or claim
editing code or tests before the successor preregistration is committed and independently approved
proposed_fix_contract.module_identity_requirement: Authority semantics must be invariant when the runner is loaded as __main__ and then imported by the validator under its package name. A second module instance must not silently create an independent authority domain; any cross-module borrow must use the exact preregistered delegation API and bind identity, root, ownership and lifetime.
proposed_fix_contract.ownership_requirement: Every temporary authority must have an explicit creator, containing write root, cleanup owner and lifetime; nested validation must not outlive or escape its parent authority.

required_preregistered_tests.exact_os_bootstrap_positive: Launch the fixed interpreter from the OS with -S -P -B and the exact minimal environment, execute the new runner as __main__, invoke the package-imported validator, complete nested authority creation inside the allowed root, and finish the full synthetic release probe.
required_preregistered_tests.module_identity_negative: Prove that an authority domain cannot unlock or borrow another domain without the exact preregistered delegation API, and that any identity, root, ownership or lifetime mismatch is rejected.
required_preregistered_tests.external_temp_negative: Attempt nested authority creation outside the active audit write root and prove fail-close before external mkdir or bundle publication.
required_preregistered_tests.authority_lifetime_negative: Prove a borrowed or nested authority is rejected after its parent scope exits and cannot be forged through a public token, closure registry or ambient environment.
required_preregistered_tests.full_registered_shape: In a disposable byte-exact synthetic repository, start the fixed interpreter from the OS with -S -P -B and the exact minimal environment, run the v2.2 runner as __main__, and use the destination and claim that are canonical for that synthetic root with no path or validation override. Complete two deterministic runs, bundle construction, nested release validation, independent replay and create-only publication, then independently compare the exact artifact and Merkle inventory. The real canonical repository, destination and claim must remain untouched.
required_preregistered_tests.failure_persistence: Only in a disposable byte-exact synthetic repository, prove that BaseException after its synthetic durable claim leaves that synthetic claim present and makes a second synthetic invocation fail before either pipeline starts. This test must never create or consume the real v2.2 claim.
required_preregistered_tests.test_byte_registration: Archive and Merkle-bind every test file whose PASS is cited as evidence for these gates.
